text: PR #5416 (stop() exception-safety, #5401) update: after the session limit reset, re-ran the round-2 adversarial review that had previously failed mid-run on the spend limit. It found two real issues in the ResetOnExit RAII guard from round 1's fix: (1) no disarm() method, so each of start()/cleanup_pending_session_layout()/stop()'s own success-path explicit transition_=idle was always followed by the still-armed guard's destructor redundantly re-locking and re-writing the same field after the enclosing lock released -- an unlock/re-lock window where a concurrent thread's legitimate transition could be silently clobbered back to idle, undermining RQ-CF-AGENT-005's single-active-session invariant; (2) the destructor's lock_guard construction had no exception handling, so a std::mutex::lock() throw would std::terminate() the whole process (implicitly-noexcept destructor) -- strictly worse than the pre-refactor catch(...) blocks it replaced. Fixed both (commit a74163705): added disarm(), called at each method's own final reset; wrapped the destructor's lock in try/catch(...) that swallows and leaves the field non-idle, which is safe since every session entry point already fails closed while non-idle. 7/7 local battery passes. Fresh Windows Native Validation dispatch (run 33359322307) and a third adversarial review pass are both running now before merge. Also opened PR #5417 (agent/v1-consolidate-path-predicates, issue #5405): consolidated the 4 hand-duplicated Windows path-safety predicates (embedded-NUL, dot-component, alias-prone, reserved-device-name) that PR #5410's colon-bypass fix had to be applied to 4 times into a single canonical src/platform/path.cpp implementation; 6/6 local tests pass (including new direct coverage at the canonical home); Windows CI (run 33358679992) running now. Also started the next slice, issue #5408 (consolidate duplicate ScopedFd/ScopedHandle RAII wrappers across physical_path_containment.cpp/audit_stream.cpp/private_directory.cpp into one canonical copperfin::platform definition each) on agent/v1-consolidate-scoped-resource -- in progress, not yet pushed.
